evidence_items.explanation: The study documents factual inconsistency and investigates removing erroneous entities from summaries. It supports the observed problem but does not isolate Marcus's proposed causal explanation across LLMs.
This establishes recurring false answers in earlier models. Its focus on imitating misconceptions also shows why false answers cannot automatically be attributed to combining otherwise correct facts.

The models demonstrated meaningful factual discrimination, although the study also found failures when inconsistent summaries appeared verbatim in the input. This qualifies a blanket account of lost factual relationships without disproving recurring errors.

unresolved_gaps: The retrieved studies do not isolate combining or paraphrasing associations as the cause of the recurring errors.
No representative task distribution establishes how often this particular failure occurs across the claimed model class.
